comparison.objective: Inspect hidden slider travel and mark the largest; candidate adjusts a damper until its physical response meets limits.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated slider actuation/inspection and marking versus tool engagement, collar adjustment, locking, guarded cycling, and response-guided iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Correct largest-travel slider must apparently be identified and marked; candidate requires two safe cycles and post-lock stability.
comparison.reason: Both involve observation across mechanical trials, but one tests comparative inspection and marking while the other tests closed-loop physical calibration. Slider rubric and spec versions are missing.
